LanguageData.HP_Setup: Choose how to initialize this world's free cities. Keeping the existing world changes no ownership. Configuring initial cities moves the reviewed NPC settlements into one REAL Free City Union faction with shared diplomacy, standard union trade/defenders and ideology. Player faction, visited towns, loaded maps, charter records and each source faction's last base are excluded. Player membership, council votes, automatic wars and conquest are not connected yet. This is world setup, not negotiated NPC independence. Gameplay validation is deferred. Closing this window defers the choice.

LanguageData.CT_Warning: DEVELOPMENT PREVIEW — Confirming changes this NPC town's REAL faction, shared diplomacy, future inhabitants, trade and faction ideology/technology. Player bases and pawns remain under player control. Visited towns can move only while unloaded, with supported saved residents and verifiably unchanged trade goods. People, corpses, nested stock and unsupported animals are excluded. Supported living world-pawn trade animals retain their identity, faction and observed health/gear/status without refactioning. Supported ordinary pack inventory and its sale/unpack settings are retained in the same original holder. Existing goods are neither regenerated nor confiscated; future trade and restocking follow the destination faction. Hostility and pending delivery block movement. Real source factions keep another base; only your verified administration may become empty. Released towns need an existing union and no newer active contract. Signing/releasing remains separate from movement. Gameplay validation is deferred.

Your own bases and pawns remain player-controlled. This preview uses industrial outlander troops, trade and ideology, rather than preserving player/local culture. Quest or permanent relation conflicts suspend mirroring. Random raids, military aid and quest sites are disabled; compatibility with every other quest/mod is untested.

Visited towns may move with preserved ordinary goods, but loaded maps, unsupported residents, people/unsupported animals or nested stock block movement. LanguageData.NS_Warning: Change the immediate liege of an existing NPC vassal within your current realm, or return it to direct player allegiance. All affected towns must already share your actual realm. The realm's living NPC representative must agree under the current policy (player goodwill at least 50). Review first, then confirm. This changes REAL saved contracts, not pawn or settlement factions. The old contract is mutually released and replaced atomically, keeping its history and the exact contracts of all descendants. Fixed tribute terms remain the same with the new direct counterpart. Four levels including the top lord are enforced across the whole tree. NPC payments are not generated. Ordinary single-town release cannot detach a lord with active descendants; reassign those children first. Whole-subtree union release is still pending. Gameplay validation is deferred.

LanguageData.NW_Warning: OPTIONAL WORLD SETUP, once per save. Create internal NPC vassal contracts among a reviewed share of existing towns in each eligible native faction, without changing their faction, residents or stock. The living faction leader represents both sides as an initial internal land arrangement, not a player-negotiated NPC independence agreement. Factions already registered in the contract book, the union, player administration, hostile/hidden/temporary/defeated/permanent-enemy and royal-title factions are excluded. Existing politics and player contracts are never rewritten. The native faction is the root, with branches no deeper than four levels; at most 30 towns are configured. Terms are fixed tribute value 100 every 5 days with a 1-day grace period and 10% subject-delivery transport share. No NPC goods/payments or military events are generated. Review the towns and representatives before confirming. Gameplay validation is deferred.

LanguageData.RE_Limits: Resident migration supports 1–128 eligible saved humanlike world pawns in an unloaded town. New profile 7 also preserves supported base Gene originals, inherited/implanted classification, stored xenotype/name/icon, original order and same-tracker override links. It never adds/removes/re-expresses genes; special/custom genes or unverified dispatch remain deferred. Existing profile 6 also verifies native last/final recruitment interaction records and an exact registered conversion target without changing them or converting anyone. Eligible ordinary ideology prisoners retain their own faction/status and faith/certainty/precepts/history. Both faction and guest-status ideology notifications must be known and unpatched; role holders remain deferred. Guest settings, raw work priorities and progress are verified. Only an observed, journaled native resistance/will reset may be restored once. Later changes are never overwritten. Custom/corrupt recruiter records, unverified conversion targets, uninitialized work settings, assigned property or patched guest handling block prisoners. Slaves/guests, leaders except separate retention relocation, unsupported surgery/ideology/genes/special state, active jobs/mental/downed state and persistent restrictions remain deferred. Recorded care and supported original orders are restored; no pawn recreation or health/gear/social repair. Explicit recovery may be blocked by natural changes without blame; legacy proofs are retained.

A separate retention/relocation agreement can move an eligible saved leader reference to another unloaded, uncontracted town of the same faction. The limited NPC policy accepts this safe own-faction move while retaining office and affiliation; it does not record refusal or consent to foreign recruitment. No pawn/gear/health settings or contracts change. The native saved-inhabitant association changes; caravan travel or a future map spawn is not implemented or guaranteed. Personal joining/succession, loaded maps and special leaders remain unsupported. Pending relocation freezes political edits and new deliveries; recovery is explicit.

LanguageData.PH_Values: Fulfilled agreed value: {0}; outstanding agreed value, including reserved deliveries: {1}.
LanguageData.LS_Blocked: Succession is unavailable: check the recorded loss, unchanged subtree, pending releases, actual realm/representatives and surviving higher liege. No contract was changed.
LanguageData.LS_Completed: {0} surviving direct contracts were reconnected. Historical contracts remain recorded.
LanguageData.LS_Empty: No unresolved upper-town loss was recorded.
LanguageData.LS_Observed: {0} was destroyed. Its own territorial bond has ended; surviving vassal contracts await a separate succession review.
LanguageData.LS_Plan: {0}, representative {1}: reconnect {3} direct contracts to {2}; review {4} surviving contracts in total. Other internal bonds and old obligations remain recorded.
LanguageData.LS_Warning: Resolve only a town whose actual destruction or hostile native ownership loss Honor recorded. Review reconnects surviving vassals to the verified surviving higher liege with fresh current-representative agreement. Old conditions and history remain; residents, goods, native ownership and personal oaths are untouched. Pending releases, changed subtrees, interrupted operations and union or noble council decisions remain blocked.
LanguageData.WU_Council: Current town-member admission decisions are saved. Membership and representatives are rechecked before execution and recovery.
LanguageData.WU_Decision_MissingWarRoute: The destination cannot assume this war under the current native diplomatic restrictions.
LanguageData.WU_Decision_NoCurrentWar: The proposed enemy is no longer an actual enemy of either party. Review the changed situation.
LanguageData.WU_Decision_ProtectedAlly: The destination refused: an admitted enemy is its existing ally.
LanguageData.WU_Decision_Relationship: The destination refused: its current relationship with you is insufficient for this war burden.
LanguageData.WU_Founding: Founding admission: current representative agrees; there are no existing town members.
LanguageData.WU_PlannedHostility: {0}: retain or assume hostility after accepted admission.
LanguageData.WU_Policy: The union must agree before taking on new enemies. Existing town members receive one base vote each; no unknown contribution or population grants extra weight. A strict majority is required. Founding admission is reviewed by the current union representative. Existing allies and native diplomatic restrictions are protected.
LanguageData.WU_Progress: War admission: {0}/{1} native outcomes verified. Uncertain or completed declarations are not automatically repeated; recovery requires a fresh review.
LanguageData.WU_Propose: Propose admission with my existing wars
LanguageData.WU_Provider: War admission is paused while Hegemony or World Domination is active. Their political records need a dedicated optional adapter; Honor will not bypass them with a native-only declaration.
LanguageData.WU_Refused: Current destination consent is unavailable. Review the current decision authority and enemies again.
LanguageData.LS_Freeze: An upper town's lost authority is awaiting reviewed succession. Reconnect its surviving contracts before changing allegiance, signing/releasing charters, starting a city transfer, configuring the world or making a new physical tribute delivery. Existing records and debts remain. Offered player contracts may still be declined.
LanguageData.HL_Observed: {0} changed to a hostile NPC owner. Its prior incoming territory charter has ended; surviving child contracts and existing debts remain. Upper-town succession requires a separate review.
LanguageData.HL_Limits: Hostile ownership observations record only a completed change between already hostile NPC owners, outside pending political operations. Hegemony and World Domination need a dedicated integration first. These observations do not prove a battle or create conquest contracts. To reconnect children, the recorded new owner and the surviving former realm must still be verifiable. Later recapture and interrupted changes need separate handling.
LanguageData.WF_Policy: Feudal admission needs a mutually signed active charter AND the current ruler's separate acceptance of the existing wars. The ruler requires goodwill of at least 50 and protects existing allies and diplomatic restrictions. The union still uses its council rules. Royal governments needing a noble council are not covered by this ruler decision. No protection or military-aid duty is created by war admission.
LanguageData.WF_Authority: This authority needs a separate government or noble-council procedure. A ruler decision cannot substitute for it.
LanguageData.WF_Accepted: {0}, current ruler {1}, accepted the reviewed existing wars separately from the signed charter.
LanguageData.LC_Warning: Normally completed losses of unchanged original descendants can share one review. Each needs its own exact native loss record in the same former realm. Select the current highest recorded loss to reconnect every surviving frontier contract together, skipping only recorded lost ancestors. Missing references are never proof. Interrupted operations, changed ownership and unsupported councils remain blocked.
LanguageData.LC_Scope: Review all {0} recorded losses as one scope. Empty survivor sets can be closed explicitly; old records remain.
LanguageData.LC_Observed: {0} was lost after its upper town. Its own incoming bond has ended; review it with the current highest recorded loss. Surviving internal contracts and old debts remain.
LanguageData.LM_Warning: If a higher town is lost after one or more unresolved lower scopes, its own verified native loss can adopt those exact earlier scopes. Old IDs, event order, original graphs and proofs stay unchanged. Review the current highest loss and every adopted record together. Completed receipts are never adopted or overwritten. Foreign realms, changed contracts, missing proof and pending operations remain blocked. This merges loss reviews, not factions.
LanguageData.LM_Observed: {0} was lost above existing unresolved loss records. Their original proofs remain; select this current higher scope to review all survivors together.
LanguageData.OR_Limits: An isolated upper town's recorded hostile ownership loss may be followed by an observed return to its original registered NPC owner. If that owner differs from the contract baseline, the exact matching root transfer completed before the loss and an unchanged current journal are required. This is ownership evidence, not battle legitimacy or a revived charter. Separately reviewed succession reconnects children to their original higher party; the returned town needs a new charter and fresh consent. Unproven migrations, overlapping losses, providers and later ownership attempts remain excluded.
LanguageData.OR_Observed: {0}: return to the original owner was observed. The old charter remains ended. Review descendant succession separately; new town terms require a new charter.
LanguageData.OR_Review: This review uses the exact observed ownership return. It reconnects only descendant contracts to the original higher party. The old town charter remains ended; a later new charter needs separate current consent.
LanguageData.PL_Limits: A normally completed destruction of an unloaded, empty leaf town can be reviewed during an idle standalone transfer or a paused applied political transition. Native execution, people, animals, goods, custody and subtree exits remain excluded. A loss is recorded separately from a successful transfer.
LanguageData.PU_Limits: An empty upper town also qualifies during an isolated standalone transfer when its entire surviving subtree and original higher authority remain in the same actual ordinary realm. Reconciliation preserves the children and opens a separate succession review; it grants no automatic independence or ownership changes. Coordinated, overlapping and changed-owner upper losses remain excluded.
LanguageData.PU_Continue: {0}: the destroyed town's incoming bond and pending transfer are closed. Descendant contracts and debts remain preserved. Review succession separately before reconnecting them.
LanguageData.PI_Overlap: Several empty leaf towns were destroyed during this paused political transition. Acknowledge each original loss separately. Later observations must match a preserved original command/book head and the same physical ledger. Every confirmation preserves the actual prior order. Remaining city migration stays paused until all recorded losses are resolved. Upper towns, physical custody, changed wars or unrelated book changes remain unsupported.
LanguageData.PL_Observed: {0} was destroyed while its standalone transfer was pending. Original journals remain; review the recorded destruction explicitly.
LanguageData.PL_Pending: A positive destruction record awaits review. Ordinary transfer recovery cannot replace this loss review.
LanguageData.PL_Confirm: {0}: acknowledge the recorded destruction, close its incoming territory charter, and retain all terms, old signatures, debts and transfer history? No ownership or goods are changed. No successful transfer, mutual release or dishonor is invented.
LanguageData.PL_Completed: {0}: the territory charter is closed and the transfer is recorded as destroyed. Old history and debts remain.
LanguageData.PL_Blocked: The original loss, journal or current object state cannot be verified. Records remain unchanged; review is required.
LanguageData.PL_Coordinated: This loss belongs to the exact paused political intent. Confirmation preserves its original follower list and records one separate loss; resuming still requires every surviving follower, source rights and fresh diplomacy.
LanguageData.PS_CompleteWithLoss: Political transition complete: shared diplomacy and every surviving follower destination confirmed; {0} original town(s) were separately recorded as destroyed, not successfully transferred.
LanguageData.PS_LossProgress: Original followers: {1}; separately acknowledged destroyed towns: {0}. All other original followers still require current verification.
LanguageData.PI_Pending: This is a separate actual loss before a city move starts or after a verified completed move. Prior transfers remain unchanged. The original political follower list and all surviving followers still require verification.
LanguageData.PI_Confirm: {0}: confirm the recorded actual destruction, close only its incoming territory charter and retain debts, signatures and every previous transfer outcome? No transfer is fabricated or changed; the loss is a separate political event.
LanguageData.FM_Limits: Consent preparation only. Whole-faction merger execution is not implemented. No city, pawn, office, faction, diplomacy, goods, debt or third-party right is changed. Existing last-base restrictions remain. Personal leader joining/succession and full preservation require separate execution and review.
LanguageData.FM_Policy: Explicit proposal rule for ordinary rulers: goodwill toward the player at least 75, reciprocal alliance with the actual player administration and identical current external wars. All actual source towns need existing managed charters. No noble/collective authority is inferred. NPC response and player confirmation are separate; an unanswered acceptance expires after three days.
LanguageData.FM_Scope: {0} → {1}; representative: {2}; actual towns: {3}; native affiliated pawn identities: {4}.
LanguageData.FM_NpcAccepted: NPC political consent; awaiting player confirmation
LanguageData.FM_ReasonAccepted: The documented ordinary-ruler proposal rule accepted this exact scope; it is not native engine merger authority.
LanguageData.FM_ReasonInternalAlliance: NPC response: no reciprocal alliance with the destination administration.
LanguageData.FM_ReasonExternalWars: NPC response: existing external wars differ; no war is assumed or declared.
LanguageData.FM_ConfirmText: Record separate player confirmation after checking the same current ruler, all towns, affiliated identities, contracts and diplomacy? Merger execution is unavailable; this neither transfers assets nor waives preservation, personal consent, succession, debt or third-party rights.
LanguageData.FM_Expired: Response period expired; original NPC response remains in history.
LanguageData.FM_Blocked: Merger proposal unavailable or review changed. Resolve pending operations, current authority, complete town charters or diplomacy first. No merger was executed.
LanguageData.FM_Recorded: Separate political merger consent recorded. Cities and people remain unchanged; merger execution is not available yet.
LanguageData.LJ_Limits: New agreements also retain supported original base genes and raw xenotype metadata; special/custom genes stay blocked. Older agreements keep their original preservation profile. Separate PERSONAL joining: a supported ordinary world leader may join the player administration and be assigned to an unloaded destination town. Existing source residence is moved; a leader absent from all current/retained registered town rosters is added only at the destination. The source keeps at least two towns and selects its actual successor through the native system. Requires goodwill75 and reciprocal alliance, original supported unstarted surgical orders (held separately during affiliation and reattached before completion), supported identity/faith/callbacks and preserved stock/rosters. Only during this execution, successor generation cannot redress existing world pawns or create new family relations. No city ownership, whole-faction merger, travel/arrival guarantee, release, dishonor or debt reset is created.
LanguageData.LJ_UnassignedConfirm: Request separate personal consent from {0}, who is a world leader with no association in any current or retained registered town roster, to join the actual player administration and add the same pawn to {2}'s saved roster? {1} is only the reviewed source charter, not an invented former residence. Native source succession is recorded before affiliation. Original identity, health, gear, relations, care, stocks, contracts and debts remain protected. This is not whole-faction merger or a travel/arrival guarantee.
LanguageData.LJ_Proposal: {0}: personal joining and saved assignment to {1}
LanguageData.LJ_Confirm: Request separate personal consent from {0}, join the actual player administration, and move their saved association from {1} to {2}? This is not city/whole-faction merger consent. The source selects a successor; existing people, health, gear, relationships, care, stock, contracts and debts remain protected. Uncertain calls are not replayed; changed/unsupported state can block explicit recovery.
LanguageData.LJ_Pending: Personal joining pending: {0}, {1} → {2}. Original actor and successor evidence are retained.
LanguageData.LJ_Recover: Explicitly recheck and continue personal joining
LanguageData.LJ_Completed: {0} personally joined; native source successor and saved assignment at {1} verified. This does not confirm caravan travel or later map appearance.
LanguageData.LJ_Unavailable: Personal joining unavailable/incomplete. Original intent and actors are retained. Verify supported saved leader, surviving source, own administration, reciprocal diplomacy, stock/rosters, callbacks and exact observed successor/care. No uncertain call was replayed.
LanguageData.LJ_Applying: affiliation call started; uncertain calls are never repeated
LanguageData.LJ_Observed: target affiliation and successor observed; care/residency verification
LanguageData.LJ_SuccessionApplying: source succession started; only a positive current office may be observed
LanguageData.LJ_SuccessionRecorded: source successor recorded; affiliation has not started
LanguageData.ND_Limits: NPC hierarchy changes and town-loss succession currently require a supported ordinary realm's current living, awake representative. Union councils, royal decision procedures and external authority providers require their own consent adapters; a ruler's identity alone is not a collective decision. Reopen reviews after changing saves.
LanguageData.ND_Unsupported: This realm requires a separate collective, royal or provider authority procedure. No council vote, permission, release or signature was inferred from its ruler.
LanguageData.ND_Unavailable: The current game or realm representative is unavailable or changed. Review again when the same registered, willing, decision-capable and unreserved representative holds the unique current office. Existing contracts and debts remain unchanged.
LanguageData.LS_SeparateRealm: The recorded NPC realm is different from the player's current political authority. Reconnection uses that original realm's current consent and the verified original higher player/NPC party. It changes only the reviewed contracts; towns, people, resources, allegiance and diplomacy are not moved or rewritten. Changed survivor/higher ownership remains blocked.
LanguageData.CN_Limits: For player-liege NPC town charters only. A current ordinary representative must agree to both release and acceptable new terms. Confirmation ends the old charter by mutual consent and signs a new one atomically. Old terms, debts, child contracts and ownership history remain. Affiliation, people and goods stay unchanged. NPC tribute collection remains outside this feature.
LanguageData.CN_Review: Review new terms with the current representative
LanguageData.CN_Ready: {0}, represented by {1}, accepts the reviewed renewal under the ordinary NPC policy.
LanguageData.CN_Confirm: Confirm mutual release and the new charter
LanguageData.CN_Warning: Mutually end the old charter and sign the reviewed same-party replacement now? Old signatures, conditions, debts and every child contract remain in history. Current authority, ownership and terms are checked again before anything is committed.
LanguageData.CN_Completed: The old charter was mutually released and the new same-party charter signed. Original economic history and all child contracts remain intact.
LanguageData.CN_Unavailable: The NPC does not accept these terms, or the current representative, ownership, charter or pending operations cannot be verified. Original records remain unchanged.
LanguageData.CP_Terms: Separate agreement for an active player vassal sharing the liege's diplomacy. The current ordinary liege must be a reciprocal ally with goodwill at least 75. Covers manual native friendly-aid requests to player home settlements under an active shared-enemy attack above the native aid threshold. At most one request per liege per game day, with no additional payment. New agreement waits while actual tribute is overdue or billing history is incomplete.
LanguageData.CP_Limits: Aid uses normal game AI. An arrival is not proof of victory or complete protection performance. Unavailable, failed or interrupted aid never establishes intentional refusal, dishonor or independence rights. Nothing is automatically dispatched. Ordinary rulers with the Vile trait deliberately refuse fresh requests only after positive native dispatch and matching combat-group capability checks. Such decisions are recorded separately. The initial independence route can also move the complete vassal-town hierarchy from the original realm when both realms are nonhostile and every town has no saved residents and passes stock and source-base checks. Unresolved transfers and new declarations remain unsupported.
LanguageData.CP_Agree: Review and accept this protection agreement
LanguageData.CP_Blocked: Protection request unavailable. Check the current charter, shared allegiance, ordinary allied ruler, active shared-enemy attack, daily cooldown and pending records.
LanguageData.CP_Confirm: Record this one-shot request and dispatch native allied reinforcements? The daily allowance is consumed even if dispatch fails. An interrupted call cannot be replayed; arrival and battle outcome are separate.
LanguageData.CP_Arrived: Native aid returned normally and new allied arrivals were observed.
LanguageData.CP_NoVerifiedAid: No verified allied arrival outcome. This does not establish intentional refusal or dishonor.
LanguageData.CP_Uncertain: A native request was interrupted with an unknown outcome. Its intent is preserved and further aid is blocked. Only an original saved positive generation receipt permits separate identity review; dispatch never replays automatically.
LanguageData.CP_ArrivalsObserved: Normal return and new allied arrivals observed
LanguageData.CP_ReturnedFalse: Native dispatch unavailable or returned false
LanguageData.CP_ReturnedUnverified: Native returned true without verified new arrivals
LanguageData.CP_GenerationAcknowledged: Saved generation acknowledged; full dispatch return remains unknown
LanguageData.CP_ReviewGeneration: Review the recorded arrivals from this interrupted request
LanguageData.CP_ConfirmGeneration: {0} exact recorded reinforcements are currently present with their original faction on the original map. Acknowledge the saved generation outcome? The full dispatch return, orders, victory and complete protection performance remain unverified. This never repeats dispatch or changes people or orders. Only the pending-aid block is cleared; the original request time, quota and history remain.
LanguageData.CP_GenerationSaved: Saved reinforcement generation acknowledged. The full dispatch result remains unknown; original request time and history are retained.
LanguageData.CN_PlayerLimits: For an active, unsuspended player vassal already sharing the same ordinary liege's diplomacy. Every existing NPC follower must already belong to that same actual realm. The current ruler must accept mutual release and new terms using actual same-party tribute history. Confirmation updates the signed charter and political contract reference together. No city, person, goods or diplomacy is moved.
LanguageData.CN_PlayerWarning: End the old charter by mutual consent and sign a new one under the SAME liege? Old debts, signatures, follower contracts and war history remain. Physical tribute for the new charter must be enabled separately. The old charter's supplementary protection agreement ends with it; review a separate agreement for the new charter. Native player control, actual realm and diplomacy remain unchanged.
LanguageData.CR_Confirm: End this charter by mutual agreement with {0}, represented by {1}? Current ordinary authority requires at least 50 goodwill and reciprocal nonhostility. Existing debts and descendants remain. Tribute closes at the agreed time. This does not move cities, change allegiance or grant independence; review any later political transition separately.
LanguageData.UP_Policy: Peaceful union admission: one base vote per current member town and a strict majority. NPC base policy approves at 50 goodwill; an empty union uses its current founding representative at -50. Original incoming towns gain votes after coordinated admission completes. This grants no authority to assume new wars.
LanguageData.UP_Decision: Membership admission: {0}/{1} base votes in favor. {2} Original consent is saved; recovery reviews the current council and preserves every earlier decision.
LanguageData.UW_Incoming: Wartime admission includes {0} incoming towns. They gain council votes after coordinated admission completes; pending seat exclusions require the original plan and each actual completed migration receipt. Verified war declarations are retained and never replayed during recovery.
LanguageData.AR_Source: The complete accompanying estates and migration plan reviewed at admission are retained. Recovery checks that original scope even after some towns have moved; existing contracts and debts remain.
LanguageData.FA_Consent: The current ordinary ruler accepts applying this signed charter. Original consent is retained; a changed ruler or unavailable authority needs explicit recovery review. Royal and collective decisions require their own procedure and are not inferred from one ruler.
LanguageData.CP_Refused: {0}: {1} deliberately refused this contracted defense request despite passing native availability and combat-group capability checks. The original decision is retained separately from unsuccessful or interrupted aid. No troops were generated or dispatched. A separately reviewed initial independence route is available when its scope is supported.
LanguageData.LX_Confirm: Exercise the recorded right and join {0}? The original charter ends without a fabricated NPC release; existing tribute debts remain. The initial path requires all vassal towns to be in the original realm, mutual nonhostility between the old realm and the union, no unresolved transfers, and current union consent without an additional war declaration. Every town must have no saved residents and pass stock and source-base checks. Pending town losses remain unsupported.
LanguageData.LX_Unavailable: Lawful independence is unavailable for this scope. The initial path requires the unchanged original charter and refusal, all vassal towns in the original realm, mutual nonhostility, no unresolved transfers, and current union consent without an additional declaration. Every town must have no saved residents and pass stock and source-base checks. Pending town losses remain unsupported.
